description: This Java class 'ComponentLoaderConfig' manages the loading and parsing of 'component-load.xml' files for Apache OFBiz components, including retrieving root components, parsing XML configurations, and defining component types and locations.

classes.name: ComponentLoaderConfig
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to load and parse component configuration XML files, and manage component definitions.

classes.name: ComponentDef
classes.description: Inner class representing a component or component directory with location and type.

methods.name: getRootComponents
methods.description: Returns list of root directory components defined in classpath by reading 'component-load.xml'.

methods.name: getComponentsFromConfig
methods.description: Parses a given 'component-load.xml' URL to extract component definitions.

methods.name: parseDocumentFromUrl
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML document from a URL, throwing exception on failure.
